chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Stockholm, 2012, Sweden against England. A long ball forward. Joe Hart races out of his goal and heads it away. Zlatan Ibrahimovic... bicycle kick, from thirty yards!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Slow motion. The keeper is far off his line. Zlatan has his back to goal, so he jumps and kicks the ball over his head.

chapters.label: Behind the net
chapters.text: It loops over a defender, bounces, and drops into the net. Goal of the Year!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your lesson: keep checking where the keeper is. If they come off their line, look up. You can score from far out!
